findings.key_quote: Automotive sales revenue decreased $6.66 billion, or 9%, in the year ended December 31, 2025 as compared to the year ended December 31, 2024, due a decrease of approximately 8% in cash deliveries and a lower average selling price per unit driven by sales mix and higher customer incentives such as attractive financing options.
findings.justification: This evidence directly states that automotive sales revenue decreased in 2025 compared to 2024, and explicitly identifies the causes as both a decrease in cash deliveries (approximately 8%) and a lower average selling price per unit. The passage establishes that lower average selling prices were one of the two primary drivers of the revenue decline, which entails the assertion that the decline was driven primarily by lower average selling prices.
